description: Fictional research reference rubric, not any bank regulation.

definitions.close: Flagged concern supported by adequate corroboration and no material unresolved question in supplied review scope.
definitions.investigate: Material unanswered question remains without a verified policy referral condition.
definitions.escalate: A verified fictional policy referral condition is met, regardless of other questions.

referral_criteria.description: At least two outgoing payments to the same supplier account recorded after a documented internal instruction specifically requiring senior review for that account; supplied independent register confirms the payee is not approved and no authorized change is recorded.
required_evidence: payment ledger documenting two post-instruction transfers

limitations: No automatic SAR filing or determination of financial crime
Unknown source of funds cannot be presumed from chronological proximity
Recommendations always subject to human review
